f.292.summary: Fra Guglielmo Vizani writes from Prinkipo to the French ambassador at Constantinople: a person in code asks whether 4,000 scudi were promised by the ambassador's order, and 'Monsignor Beria' (by Satoru's identification Cyril Kontaris of Veroia) is close to obtaining the Patriarchate and hopes for a change within two months; Kontaris replaced Lucaris in June 1638.
f.292.en:
"Signor [231] has sent to ask me whether the four thousand scudi [?] to [31] of Monsignor Beria, by Your Excellency's
order, were promised to the said Signor, who … is close to obtaining the patriarchate for himself. … [64?] Monsignor
Beria hopes that within two months he will be changed; the [36] has been given(?) to a partisan of his, and for his
[198] to obtain his aim at [227] is most uncertain." The clear passages say that the orders changed on 30 May and that
nothing can be said by letter while the plague lasts.

system: Homophonic symbol cipher with word dividers, signs for tt and ss, word signs for il and che, and numeric name codes.
